title: Home page — slider handle, thermostat and tab row, built

steps.path: Pages → Home, any brightness or volume bar
steps.headline: Does the round handle now look attached to the bar, with no straight edge of fill showing beside it?
steps.changed: The fill now ends in a round cap exactly behind the handle, so the handle reads as the rounded tip of the fill at every value.
steps.notice: Drag a light's brightness bar slowly from empty to full, and the soundbar's volume bar. Look at the handle at 0%, halfway and 100%. Switch themes with the buttons at the top right.
steps.risk: Below 10% volume the speaker icon inside the bar hides, because the handle would sit on top of it.

steps.headline: Is the Home page's thermostat now the Climate page's design, and does it fit the room card?
steps.changed: The room card and Favourites show the Climate page's dial (arc, set point, now-dot) with − and + either side and the modes underneath, scaled down to fit.
steps.notice: Scroll to Upstairs: press − and + and a mode. Then press the Climate pill and compare with the big one there.
steps.risk: On a very narrow window the dial shrinks a little more so nothing overflows.

steps.path: Pages → Home, the row of pills at the top
steps.headline: When you change pages, does the row of pills now stay perfectly still?
steps.changed: The selected pill's fill no longer glides between pills, and the selected pill is no longer bold, so it no longer grows and pushes its neighbours.
steps.notice: Press Lights, Media, Climate, Problems, Activity and Home in turn, and the gear. Only the page below should slide.
steps.risk: The selected tab is now marked by its fill colour alone.
